items.detail: Focused run under default env (env -i, no AUGER_* vars; pytest.ini injects none — verified by cat pytest.ini) gave 'tests/test_spec_ingest.py::test_shipped_blocks_are_verbatim_and_manifests_reconcile[code-factory] PASSED' + '2 passed in 0.24s', exit_code 0 — PASSED, not SKIPPED, because the manifest binds source_revision f72dce5a1cc8869232c2993aad21eca5b455095b (corpora/code-factory/manifest.json), live code-factory HEAD 3b0e20e5 is a descendant, and `git diff --stat f72dce5a HEAD -- specs/` is EMPTY (no upstream spec change), so containment genuinely holds. Fresh full gate on this host: GATE_FULL=1 DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bash tests/gate.sh (detached pid 5573) produced '876 passed, 2 skipped in 943.94s (0:15:43)', 'LIVE ARMS: ran 2; skipped 0', 'GATE PASS', 'GATE_EXIT_CODE=0' (/tmp/aug198-gate.log) — full mode exits 0, so the OR's first prong is satisfied; the typed-skip alternative was additionally proven to work: a drifted scratch git tree yields 'SKIPPED tests/test_spec_ingest.py:368: upstream source drift past the manifest's recorded revision (corpus bound to f72dce5a…, live tree at f0b6151d…) — regenerate corpora/code-factory with scripts/ingest_markdown_specs.py to re-bind', and a failure AT the bound revision stays hard: manifest bound to the drifted rev → 'FAILED tests/test_spec_ingest.py:378: AssertionError'. Assertions not weakened: the unconditional `assert body in normalized` remains as fallback at tests/test_spec_ingest.py:378 and executes in every no-drift case; the portable digest leg (test_shipped_block_digests_match_manifest) is untouched (its only mention in the d537d47 diff is new skip-message text); last commit touching the file is d537d47.

items.criterion: Derived: the new drift classification provides no false-green escape hatch (a wrong corpus cannot silently pass the code-factory leg on this host)
items.detail: Empirical 2x2 over (manifest revision, live tree content): drifted live rev + revision-bearing manifest → typed SKIP naming both revisions (tests/test_spec_ingest.py:368, output quoted above); live rev == bound rev + drift → hard FAIL (AssertionError, test_spec_ingest.py:378). The skip fires only when BOTH recorded_revision and live_revision are set and differ (tests/test_spec_ingest.py:354-358): removing source_revision from the manifest → FAILED; pointing the pin at a non-git tree (no live revision resolvable via _live_source_revision, tests/test_spec_ingest.py:148-166 returns None on rc!=0) → FAILED. On this host the arm is a genuine PASSED with containment re-checked over all 102 blocks.

items.criterion: Derived: all parametrized legs of the reconciliation test reconcile genuinely on this host (auger-docs, rebound by this task's fix c529571, included)
items.detail: `env -i … -m pytest tests/test_spec_ingest.py::test_shipped_blocks_are_verbatim_and_manifests_reconcile -v` → '[code-factory] PASSED [auger-docs] PASSED [coding-hermes-director] PASSED' '3 passed in 0.77s' exit 0; no SKIPPED line in -rs output. corpora/auger-docs/manifest.json records source_revision 80598140eb510837586e43757415c6681cf5aed6 (the post-AUG-206 docs state, commit c529571).

items.criterion: Derived: pre-AUG-198 manifests without source_revision keep the original hard-fail behavior (back-compat of the reconciliation leg)
items.detail: Manifest with source_revision removed + drifted live tree → 'FAILED tests/test_spec_ingest.py::test_shipped_blocks_are_verbatim_and_manifests_reconcile[code-factory]' (1 failed in 0.07s), matching the commit's stated contract (d537d47: 'A manifest without `source_revision` … keeps the original hard-fail behavior untouched'); the skip condition at tests/test_spec_ingest.py:354-358 requires a truthy recorded_revision. Converter side: scripts/ingest_markdown_specs.py:346-367 returns None outside git and only sets manifest['source_revision'] when truthy (lines 600-602, 760-762), so new manifests in non-git trees keep the old shape.
